---
title: Getting Started
---

The rules for breakpoint-keyed `text:`:

- The keys are `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` and `xxl`.
- Each variant applies from its breakpoint up to the next key.
- The lowest key also covers every narrower width, so `xs` is
  optional. The "API" item in the navbar has only `lg` and `xxl`.
- An empty string shows no text in its range. With `icon:`, this
  gives an icon-only item, like the GitHub link.
- Each variant is markdown, like an ordinary `text:` string.

The variants follow the window width, not the navbar's state. To give
the collapsed menu (below `collapse-below`) its own text, add an `xs`
key, as the "Getting Started" item does.

The [configuration page](configuration.qmd) covers what happens with a
mistyped key.
